specification.objective: Correct the canonical navigation golden harness so Flutter Material icons render as real glyphs, regenerate all four snapshots on the same Ubuntu Flutter 3.47.2 runtime used by CI, and document a command that actually selects those four tests.

requirements.statement: Load both Roboto and the Flutter SDK's MaterialIcons font before pumping each canonical navigation visual case.

Regenerate desktop-light, desktop-dark, mobile-light, and mobile-dark PNGs under the pinned Ubuntu Flutter 3.47.2 runtime so the navigation, logout, fingerprint, and selected-route icons appear as their distinct glyphs.
Update the visual validation README to state the pinned Ubuntu Flutter 3.47.2 requirement and use --tags canonical-golden rather than the unmatched plain-name filter.
Keep production UI and runtime behavior unchanged; this is a visual-test fidelity and documentation correction.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The visual test loads the MaterialIcons family from the active Flutter SDK before widget pumping and fails if the font is unavailable.
All four canonical golden tests pass on Ubuntu with Flutter 3.47.2, and the four committed PNGs show distinct actual icon glyphs rather than missing-glyph squares.
The documented update command selects and updates all four tagged visual cases, with the pinned runtime requirement stated next to it.

invariants.statement: The golden test continues using the four canonical desktop/mobile light/dark cases and fixture content.
The CI golden job remains pinned to Flutter 3.47.2 on Ubuntu and runs the canonical-golden tag.

forbidden_states.statement: IconData changes can pass the golden suite because all icons render as the same missing-glyph square.
The documented regeneration command selects zero visual cases or omits the pinned Ubuntu Flutter runtime requirement.
Production widgets, app behavior, or dependencies change as part of this visual-test correction.

inputs.statement: PR #123 review finding: workspace_shell_test.dart loads Roboto but not MaterialIcons, so all navigation and related icons render as placeholder squares in the four committed screenshots.
PR #123 review finding: docs/validation/issue-119/README.md uses a plain-name filter that matches none of the four canonical-golden test names.

outputs.statement: A canonical golden suite that renders actual Material icon glyphs and detects iconography changes.
Four refreshed Ubuntu Flutter 3.47.2 navigation screenshots and a valid tagged regeneration command.

failure_semantics.statement: On the locked baseline, loading MaterialIcons with the old placeholder snapshots must fail the canonical golden test with the literal Pixel test failed mismatch; environmental/setup failures are not valid Red.

argv: from pathlib import Path; import sys; test=Path('frontend/test/features/shared/presentation/widgets/workspace_shell_test.dart').read_text(); readme=Path('docs/validation/issue-119/README.md').read_text(); ok="FontLoader('MaterialIcons')" in test and '--tags canonical-golden' in readme and '--plain-name' not in readme; print('canonical_golden_font_and_command_ok' if ok else 'canonical_golden_font_or_command_missing'); sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
